deployability.azurite: Self-hostable: local code + weights, no API dependency, runs on 1x RTX PRO 6000 (measured) and laptop CPU (reference). No data leaves the premises by construction. No SOC2/ISO certs (org-level gap).
deployability.jev: API-only as far as any primary source shows (hosted endpoint; no VPC/on-prem evidence; enterprise FAQ answer unretrievable). ZDR + SOC 2 Type II for enterprise. No region selector published. Source: results/market/v0/MARKET_REVIEW.json Q2.

failure_modes_declared: From-scratch dual transfer collapses (6 variants tested, collapse-or-freeze); dual supported with pretrained init ONLY.
Seed variance dominates (±15pp); single-seed wins are fragile by construction.
Transfer cross path caps at K=16 (banking77_cross structural fail); K>>100 needs dual or funnel.
Transfer-recipe accuracies do NOT reproduce sweep-harness highs (recipe matters more than path).

license_choice.azurite: UNRESOLVED — founder decision; do not assume MIT/Apache-2.0. Blocks enterprise use until chosen.
license_choice.jev: Proprietary, closed weights, anti-distillation/anti-compete MCA terms, output assigned to customer.

limitations: Single result seed per cell; Jev points as-recorded (no live re-query: founder-spend blocker); transfer recipe only (378 steps, tiny byte); tasks/datasets as listed; no p99/SLA/end-to-end serving claims; no cost-per-decision claim.

ag_news_reference.note: K=4 reference; full train cells: cross ~13.3s/2345MiB, dual ~19.7s/3015MiB (exec1).

per_decision_latency_source: LAT_prompt_injections.json + LAT_ag_news.json (RTX PRO 6000, fp32, 50 timed iters, cuda-synced). Not SLAs.
recipe: Execution-1 recipe (pretrained anchor, stratified split-seed 0, cross-shuffle off, batch 16, lr 5e-4, 378 steps, per-task pool-sized budgets).
